Treated wastewater discharges are disinfected by ultraviolet light (UV).
Recycled water is disinfected using chlorine (see § 2.1.4.).

The plant’s recycling facilities include a separate chlorine contact basin used only to disinfect recycled water, a one-million-gallon storage tank, and a recently constructed 1.5-million-gallon storage tank;
Biosolids generated during the treatment process are stored in two 5-million-gallon earthen clay-lined sludge storage basins, one of which is lined with an impermeable polyethylene liner.
Biosolids from the sludge storage basins are dewatered with a screw press, then hauled to a landfill.
